run_interactive_chat_with_mcp: run an interactive CLI chat with the Claude Agent SDK using MCP server integration via LiteLLM proxy
configure_claude_agent_with_mcp_servers: configure ClaudeAgentOptions with an HTTP MCP server for DeepWiki research tool access
stream_agent_responses: stream real-time responses from the Claude agent client during interactive conversation
switch_llm_models_at_runtime: switch the active LLM model during an interactive chat session without restarting
disable_mcp_and_fallback: disable MCP server integration via USE_MCP=false and fall back to basic agent mode
